propositions: A single monolithic test function comparing 884 renderable units (1768 pandoc spawns) takes 91.6s idle and 504.8s under CPU saturation, exceeding CI's 300s per-test timeout on the contended macOS py3.13 cell.

pytest-timeout with thread method kills the xdist worker process outright via os._exit(1) when the budget is crossed, producing no traceback and manifesting as 'node down: Not properly terminated' followed by worker crash.
The test cost is unbounded and load-dependent; corpus growth adds serial work directly to a single test case rather than splitting it across multiple test cases.
Chunking the equivalence comparison into fixed-size batches (40 units per chunk) via parametrization bounds per-test cost by construction and allows xdist to parallelize across workers.

All 884 units remain byte-compared against the oracle with real pandoc at stride 1, and a coverage guard test asserts that chunks reassemble to the full corpus (≥100 units), preserving the integrity property.
The fix reduces worst-case cost from 504.8s to 38.05s under saturation, eliminating the worker crash on macOS and leaving 7.9x headroom under the 300s guard.
